title: Anchored menu
plain: A menu opens from the button that caused it.
purpose: Keeps the relationship between a choice and its trigger obvious.

title: Focused dialog
plain: A focused task settles into the center, then leaves faster than it arrived.
purpose: Explains the change in focus without slowing down the decision.

title: State swap
plain: Old information yields while the new state takes its exact place.
purpose: Makes status changes readable without moving the surrounding interface.

title: Disclosure reveal
plain: Supporting information appears directly beneath the choice that revealed it.
purpose: Shows where additional detail came from without animating page layout.

title: Important notice
plain: A hidden result arrives at the edge and leaves without interrupting the task.
purpose: Reserved for outcomes the user could not otherwise see.
